 Paris R2 previews and predictions: Zverev vs. Musetti, Fils vs. Machac 
 November 3, 2026 
 Ricky 
 Match previews 
 1 
 Getty Images 
 Second-round competition at the Paris Masters continues on Wednesday, when Alexander Zverev kicks off his campaign against Lorenzo Musetti. Arthur Fils tries to recover from an injury with qualifier Tomas Machac on the other side of the net. 
 (1) Alexander Zverev vs. Lorenzo Musetti
Zverev and Musetti will be facing each other for the sixth time in their careers when they clash in round two of the Rolex Paris Masters on Wednesday. Musetti leads the head-to-head series 3-2, and they have split their two previous indoor hard-court contests. After the Italian prevailed 2-6, 7-6(5), 6-4 in Vienna two years ago, Zverev cruised 6-4, 7-5 in the semifinals of that same tournament in 2025.
It has been a busy fall swing for Musetti, both on and off the court . The world No. 24 went on a grueling run to the Lyon title, beat Frances Tiafoe in Vienna (lost to Arthur Fery in the second round), and opened in Paris with a 7-6(3), 7-6(10) defeat of Hubert Hurkacz on Monday. Zverev destroyed Fery 6-0, 6-2 in the Vienna quarters before succumbing to Alex de Minaur in a third-set tiebreaker in the semis. The world No. 1 remains in fine form but has not lifted a trophy since the U.S. Open, so he should be eager to pick up some momentum in advance of the Nitto ATP Finals.
 Pick: Zverev in 2

 (6) Arthur Fils vs. (Q) Tomas Machac
Fils is a bit of question mark heading into Paris after retiring in the Basel quarterfinals because of a leg injury, but he says he is good to go. The seventh-ranked Frenchman is in fantastic shape to qualify for the Nitto ATP Finals, but he would still do well to win a match or two this week just to be safe. 
Up first for Fils is a second showdown against Machac, who lost their only previous encounter 6-4, 6-4 on the grass courts of Halle in 2024. It has already been a productive stay in Paris for the 69th-ranked Czech, who qualified for the main draw and then dismissed Frenchman Kyrian Jacquet 7-6(7), 6-1. Unfortunately for Machac, he has dealt with injuries of his own throughout this season and has not won multiple main-draw matches at an ATP-level event since Barcelona in April.
 Pick: Fils in 2
